svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Observability stack with OpenTelemetry
svg.desc: Observability stack with OpenTelemetry. 11 components in 2 groups. Connections: Checkout to OTel Collector; Payments to OTel Collector; Search to OTel Collector; OTel Collector to Prometheus (metrics); OTel Collector to Loki (logs); OTel Collector to Tempo (traces); Prometheus to Grafana; Loki to Grafana; Tempo to Grafana; Prometheus to Alertmanager (alerts); Alertmanager to Slack; Alertmanager to PagerDuty.

text.tspan: Services export OTLP to a Collector that fans metrics, logs and traces out to Prometheus, Loki and Tempo; Grafana and Alertmanager sit on top
